additional_info.body:
Dear Marcelo
Thank you very much for your support. And your response.
I triggered an Soft reboot this morning and I can confirm you are right, the charger is now working again. But we have an issue here, please check the serialnumber and how many tickets we have already with this serialnumber. The customer is upset with the stability ob the charger.
There is no month without any issue.
Please see the 3 attached emails, the customer wrote my this morning, 3 emails in a duration of 45 minutes… the first email was at 7.24am swiss time, so please check this time stamp and provide more information regarding the issue.
The customer want a long term solution, not a reboot every second week.
Thanks for your support.
Freundliche Grüsse
Alexander Müller
